leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define the structure of design tokens
Implement a typed object that represents a complete design tokens model
Apply union types to create variant options for design token values
Configure nested token structures using TypeScript type definitions
Initialize and manipulate typed design token objects with proper type safety
Integrate the typed design tokens model into a TypeScript project structure
Update token values while maintaining type constraints and validation
